title: First Touch: Minimap Hero with Interactive Snapshot & Overlay Guides
creator: Sofia M. Delgado
description:
Objective: Replace the existing static hero with a compact, persistent minimap-style hero that anchors the quickstart journey and surfaces contextual overlay guides tied to product screenshots. This pattern aims to reduce cognitive load on first-run visitors while increasing quickstart completion rate and discovery of product features.

Design goals:
- Provide an at-a-glance path (3 primary steps + expandable details) so users understand immediate next actions without leaving the landing page.
- Support progressive disclosure: the minimap is condensed on narrow viewports and expands into annotated screenshot overlays on hover/tap.
- Maintain strong accessibility: keyboard focus order, readable contrast for overlays, and ARIA labels for each step.
- Produce a set of deliverables suitable for A/B testing vs the legacy hero (hypothesis: +7-10% quickstart starts, +4% conversion to API keys).

Constraints & assumptions:
- Frontend will implement the minimap with existing design tokens and CSS variables from design-tokens repo (see PR link).
- Animations limited to 200ms micro-interactions to preserve perceived performance and not impact SLOs on initial load.
- Must support both hosted and dedicated quickstart flows (copy variants controlled by PM).
acceptance_criteria: Figma frames for collapsed, expanded, and overlay states completed and annotated for handoff
PNG/SVG exports for documentation and docs landing page at 1200x600 and responsive sizes
Lottie or CSS micro-interaction spec exported and validated with frontend (max 200ms)
Accessibility checklist passed (contrast, keyboard navigation, ARIA descriptions)
A/B test tracking events instrumented: quickstart_open, minimap_expand, overlay_cta_click
deliverables: Copy variants: compact / explanatory / progressive (approved by PM)

decision_log: 2025-08-16 Decision: Use a persistent minimap anchored to the left of hero content instead of full-bleed interactive carousel. Rationale: reduces layout shift and is more scannable on docs pages.
2025-08-20 Decision: Overlays will be semi-transparent dim layers with numbered callouts that map to the minimap steps. Rationale: keeps screenshots readable while showing contextual guidance.
2025-08-30 Decision: Prioritize keyboard and touch parity. Implement 1-key shortcut to jump focus to minimap for screen reader users.
